title: 骑了5000多公里的正新C3045
notes: Owner post (2025-09-13): after more than 5,000 km the rear C3045 had several cracks in its crescent-shaped grooves (the front had none); the owner was satisfied with wear and puncture resistance, found it hard to mount, and replaced it with the CST C1761, a 60 TPI version about CNY 20 cheaper. Photos re-checked 2026-11-02: a mounted tire whose sidewall reads CST ENERGIA with the EPS badge, close-ups of the cracked grooves, and the replacement tire's CST CONQUISTARE sidewall.
